Ministry of Finance: This entity is identified as the governmental body issuing the notification through its Internal Resources Division.
Internal Resources Division: This division of the Ministry of Finance is the issuing authority for this customs and value added tax notification.
Government of Bangladesh: The notification is issued under the authority of the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: এস,আর,ও নং ১৩৪-আইন/২০২২/৮২/কাস্টমস। Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969) এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ (২০১২ সনের ৪৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১২৬ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, ২৪ মে, ২০২১ খ্রিস্টাব্দ মোতাবেক ১০ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৮ বঙ্গাব্দ তারিখে জারিকৃত প্রজ্ঞাপন এস,আর,ও নং ১২৯-আইন/২০২১/১৮/কাস্টমস এর নিম্নরূপ সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend notifications related to customs duties.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to issue notifications regarding tax and duty amendments.
National Board of Revenue: The Government is required to consult with this board when exercising its powers to issue or amend customs and tax-related notifications.
S.R.O. 129-AIN/2021: This existing customs notification is subject to specific amendments issued by the current order.

H.S. Code: The notification amends the H.S. Code specifications within the table of a previous customs notification. Several existing H.S. Code entries are replaced with updated codes to ensure accurate tariff classification for the affected goods. This amendment ensures consistency between the duty schedule and the specified international commodity classification system.
TABLE: The table, which serves as the reference for customs duty classification, is updated to correct and refine specific commodity codes. The amendments involve replacing outdated H.S. Code entries with current ones to reflect precise classification requirements.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ২। এই প্রজ্ঞাপন ৯ জুন, ২০২২ খ্রিস্টাব্দ তারিখে কার্যকর হইবে।

Customs Notification: This legal instrument specifies its effective date, determining when the provisions contained within the order come into legal force.
